answer: Agents wander the lagoon of tasks hunting work, and each epoch a beacon picks 10% of identities for audit. Three peers hold a lantern to the audited agent's work, and a shell that cannot show real work loses its 40-credit deposit. 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits in deposits and bleed 400 per epoch to failed audits. An honest agent risks one 40-credit deposit, is rarely audited, and keeps earning, so honesty stays cheap and forgery ruinous.
